differences: Shared15 uses one width15 relation input and eight output projections (9600 correction parameters), while original MLP16 uses eight independent width16 relations (24576).
Cap shared execution has alpha_time0; approved raw9 and original MLP16 use alpha_time1 joint time NLL plus log-MSE. The alpha0 time-head guard must not be inherited.
Uncapped original Train statistics/boundaries/quantity target digests and input SHA must replace Cap versions; time-head initialization, loader and common time/model/head source are unchanged.

limitations: Stored original MLP16 checkpoints/histories/full Validation prediction shards were read and hash-verified; no new inference or evaluation ran.
Taxi42 and RAF42 stored Validation receipts use CPU torch2.14.0; the other seven use native5080 torch2.11.0+cu130/cuDNN91900. All reproduce selected native history within rtol=atol=1e-5.
Original training OS exit receipts were not re-observed in this baseline-only audit. Selected checkpoints, finite first-min histories and full Validation receipts are verified.
No Test prediction or Test/mixed performance report was read; prior evaluation contract split metadata was allowed.

Stored endpoint rows may differ minutely from native selected training history due to CPU/CUDA arithmetic; comparison uses the stored Validation predictions, while selected native history values remain separate.
